sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8680 of 2024

Applicant :- Shivam Chauhan @ Chotu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Iqbal Ahmad,Syed Hasan Ejaz Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.123 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali Dehat, District Balrampur.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that sister of the informant was married to the applicant on 23.11.2017 and sufficient dowry was given.
Subsequently, she was being harassed by the matrimonial family and ultimately she died at the hands of the applicant who is the husband.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was observed on the body of the deceased.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Shivam Chauhan @ Chotu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 01.03.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Shivam Chauhan @ Chotu be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.8.2024 nishant  Shivam Chauhan @ Chotu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
